comment: Replayable evidence corpus for retrieval evaluation. Small on purpose: every item exists to make one retrieval decision observable (syndication collapse, crowd-text noise, cross-language phrasing, a genuine contradiction).

 评论区有人说根本没 close，全是通稿。

items.title: OpenForge 这轮融资合理吗
items.content:
楼主：OpenForge 的 B 轮我早就猜到了，三十亿估值的口径和通稿一致。

【回复精选】
 回复1：估值是虚的，钱没到账。
 回复2：通稿写的，别信。

items.title: 周末去哪玩
items.content:
楼主：求推荐周末去处。

【回复精选】
 回复1：顺便说一句，OpenForge 估值 30 亿这事我是不信的，纯炒作。

items.title: The OpenForge round did not close
items.content:
We have confirmed with two people close to the deal that the OpenForge Series B did not close; the $3 billion valuation figure was a draft that leaked.

【楼层讨论】
 floor2: I would still wait for the filing.
